# os-strati — OpenStrata Strati Template

identity: OpenStrata.NET.Strati

Short name: os-strati

Primary output: `Strati\\OstrataTemplate.1.Strati.csproj`

Description: Scaffolds a Strati project (used to generate solution artifacts via OpenStrata MSBuild Stratify tooling).

Parameters

- `ostrata-version`: (optional) default `1.*`

Usage example

```powershell
dotnet new os-strati
```
